column2: a martial artist kneeling and coughing blood, glowing crimson meridian lines bursting across his body, overflowing qi swirling around him like red mist
a martial artist meditating seen from behind, faint glowing meridian channels traced across his back, one acupuncture point bursting open with bright light
three small objects laid on a stone table over an old meridian chart: a short bamboo conduit pipe, a stone plug sealed with a red paper talisman, and a cold white jade disc giving off mist
dozens of swords raining down from the sky in a radiant circle onto a battlefield, a lone swordsman below with one hand raised
a martial artist throwing a fan of slim flying daggers, some stuck in a bandit, others streaming back in a curved line to his open hand
the bony hand of a long-dead old master clutching a single sheet of paper covered in a sword formula written in blood, inside a mossy stone cave
a mountain path splitting into three branches, one of the paths shrouded in thick dark crimson mist
a masked demonic cult assassin in black emerging from thick fog with a curved blade, eyes glinting red
a roadside crossroads under an old tree where a wandering physician, a gambler with cards and a travelling peddler with a backpack frame have gathered
a cracked rock wall broken open revealing a hidden mossy stone grotto, inside the remains of an old master sitting upright in meditation, a jade bottle and an old book beside him
a blacksmith pouring glowing molten metal from a crucible into the groove of a sword blade laid on an anvil, sparks flying
a towering martial arts master with iron gauntlets blocking a stone gate, standing in a challenging stance
the interior of a rustic wuxia inn, a waiter with a towel over his shoulder beside a display shelf of goods and medicine jars, hanging paper lanterns
a young swordsman catching his breath in front of a wooden training dummy in a quiet stone courtyard, a stone lantern beside
an old plum tree in a village in early spring, buds opening one by one along a long crooked branch, a few vivid red blossoms
a martial artist seated in meditation facing a bare rock wall inside a mountain cave, a faint glow around him
an open old bound book showing ink drawings of various artifacts such as a ring, a dagger, a gourd and a feather arranged in a grid, some squares left empty
a young swordsman performing a flowing three-strike sword combo, three sweeping ink crescent arcs around him, the third stroke biggest and heaviest, a bandit staggering back
a young swordsman lunging forward out of a quick dash with a straight piercing sword thrust, a long horizontal ink speed streak behind him, a startled bandit in front

a winding mountain path through misty layered cliffs leading up to an ancient stone gate with a faint glowing passage, a lone traveler walking toward it, several rooms of a ruined compound along the way

an old meridian acupuncture chart of a human body spread on a low wooden table, small treasures and trinkets placed on glowing points along the channels, flowing qi lines connecting them, a brush and inkstone beside it
a young swordsman in dark robes darting swiftly across a bamboo forest clearing, leaving a few fading ink afterimages of himself behind him as he dashes, fallen leaves swirling in his wake
a young swordsman spinning in a whirlwind sword technique, a ring of ink brush strokes around him, behind him a huge ghostly golden sword silhouette rising in the sky as his ultimate technique
a martial artist sitting cross-legged, the meridian lines across his body pale grey and faint, only a thin weak trickle of qi reaching a small treasure placed before him, its glow dim and flickering
a merchant at a roadside inn counter weighing silver taels on small brass scales, a traveler handing over a curious trinket in exchange for a pouch of silver coins, abacus and ledger beside
a lone swordsman looking back over his shoulder on a dark forest road, far behind him masked assassins in black with red sashes slipping through the trees, red lantern marks on a hanging map
